title: Feels nice, washed - laid it down to dry & was wrinkled!
text:
Feels nice, washed - laid it down to dry & was wrinkled!. The color silver gray is Neutral and a nice color without a blue-hue to it.
There is a hidden zipper , fits a queen pillow good.
This feels soft, but not slippery to slid off the bed.

I washed this one silk pillow case in a laundry bag in my front load washer on warm, then laid it on the dryer to dry.
When it was dry, it’s very wrinkled, but pulling on the pillow it came out ok.
This feels nice on my face to sleep on, but my high count Egyptian Cotton linens that have lasted for years feels nicer to me,
Or was I expecting more from a silk pillowcase!
